content: Can these replaced pulleys be reused on the MK4S?  Shame if we toss it.
I had a square nut fall out in this step.  be careful!
I was able to do the next section without cutting the zip tie, but it was harder. You decide

replies.content: I also left the zip tie. If doing the INDX conversion at the same time, leaving the zip tie was fine since the tube isn't in the way.

content:
From experience I know that once the grub screws have been tightened on the motor shaft that it is almost impossible to remove the pulley without applying significant pulling force to overcome the friction caused by displaced metal where the grub screws have bitten into the shaft.

Will this cause damage to the motor?
